description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Northrop Grumman develops mission-critical systems and next-generation national defense capabilities for global security. The Associate Software Engineer will design, develop, document, test, and debug software applications and systems while collaborating across engineering disciplines. The role also involves containerized development, system analysis, software standards, and DevOps processes.
Associate software engineer developing, testing, and containerizing systems software across operating system, network, database, and application layers

Responsibilities:
• The new team member will design, develop, document, test and debug software applications and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions
• Conduct multidisciplinary research and collaborates with equipment designers and/or hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of software solutions
• Determine computer user needs; analyzes system capabilities to resolve problems on program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques and controls; prepares operating instructions; designs and develops compilers and assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems
• Implement solutions in multiple components of the system, including storage, OS, network, application, database, and many more
• Provide system analysis as an actual user, including onsite visits, and contribute to the next iteration of the system through feedback and development
• Ensure software standards are met
• Build and enhance software, leveraging feedback as an end user and field rep
• Use container engines and container tools to develop OCI-compliant container images for existing software applications (e.g. Docker images)
• Design, develop, document, test and debug applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions
• Follow software development standards for configuration management, software reuse, and Dev\*Ops processes

Requirements:
• STEM degree:

o BS
• Object-oriented development in Java, or C/C++
• Scripting and web: Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
• Data and storage: SQL/relational databases
• Linux experience: filesystems/mounts, cron, bash scripting, services, permissions, users/groups
• DevOps: GitLab (repos, runners, pipelines), integration with artifact/binary storage, use of monitoring tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Grafana)
• Networking: practical troubleshooting with tools like ss, nc, netstat, tcpdump, ip addr; understanding of core protocols and debugging strategies
• Understanding of containers, containerized development, and deployment
• End-to-end software development lifecycle experience
• Ability to obtain clearance
• US Citizenship

Preferred:
• Hands-on design, deployment, and dynamic management of containerized systems
• Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and pub/sub (topics) architectures
• Proficiency using REACT framework
• Experience with Kubernetes (K8s, k3s) and cloud-native OS environments
• Experience with modern software factories and DevOps/DevSecOps practices
• Familiarity with Atlassian and CI/CD tools: Bitbucket, JIRA, Jenkins, Confluence
• Advanced scripting in Python, Bash, and related languages
• Practical experience working in Agile and DevOps teams
• Strong background in object-oriented software design and implementation
• Experience with both front-end and back-end User Interface development
